verdict.stance: Constructive / South Africa's #1 REIT Deleveraging to 38.7% LTV (Ba2 Pos)
verdict.summary: Growthpoint is South Africa's largest listed REIT with R8.75bn annualized EBITDA, R5.2bn FY26 distributable income, and group LTV improved to 38.7% (down from 40.1%). Moody's Ba2 Positive rating (and Aaa(za) national scale upgrade) reflects V&A Waterfront strength, stabilizing SA office/retail fundamentals, and active DMTN market access (GRT74 listed Nov-26).

positives: Flagship trophy assets including 50% stake in V&A Waterfront (Cape Town) and Growthpoint Australia (GOZ).
LTV steadily reduced to 38.7% in FY26 (from 40.1%) with deep domestic DMTN institutional demand.
Moody's Ba2 Positive outlook and Aaa(za) national-scale upgrade track SA sovereign improvement.
negatives: South African office sector vacancy and reversionary rental pressures outside Cape Town.
Interest rate sensitivity across floating ZAR/AUD debt facilities.
Domestic ZAR issuance concentration limits hard-currency Eurobond liquidity.

background.business_overview: South Africa's largest REIT across SA logistics/retail/office, V&A Waterfront (50%), Australia (GOZ), and UK/CEE (Capital & Regional / GWI).
background.asset_perimeter: Diversified R170bn+ property portfolio across SA, Australia, and Europe.
background.ownership_governance: Widely held JSE Top-40 REIT (JSE: GRT).

recent_drivers: FY26 (Jun-26): Distributable income R5.2bn, annualized EBITDA ~R8.75bn (~71% margin), LTV reduced to 38.7%.
Nov-26: Listed GRT74 senior unsecured DMTN notes (ZAG000230426); Moody's maintains Ba2 Positive / Aaa(za).

catalysts.impact: Tracks SA office occupancy and LTV <=38% progress.
